story: Mia and Sam go to the cinema to watch a film. The film tells an exciting story about an Italian singer. After the movie, Sam wants to draw a picture of the dancing Lily. Sam is also a talented writer.
title: A Day at the Cinema
setting: A dark cinema and a bright room after the movie.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: A young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater.

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: A young boy with glasses and a blue shirt.

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: A girl with long blonde hair wearing a yellow dress.

sentences.en: Mia and Sam go to the cinema.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia with short brown hair and Sam with glasses walk toward a building with a large screen icon.

sentences.en: The film is an exciting story.
sentences.zh: 这部电影是一个令人兴奋的故事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam sit in dark cinema seats watching a bright, colorful screen.

sentences.en: An Italian singer starts to sing.
sentences.zh: 一位意大利歌手开始唱歌。
sentences.scene_prompt: On the cinema screen, a man in a suit sings into a silver microphone.

sentences.en: They watch a very long movie.
sentences.zh: 他们看了一部很长的电影。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam watch the large cinema screen with wide eyes.

sentences.en: Lily does a beautiful dance now.
sentences.zh: Lily现在跳了一段美丽的舞蹈。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily with long blonde hair performs a graceful dance on a stage in the film.

sentences.en: Sam wants to draw the dancing Lily.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam sits at a table with a pencil and paper, looking at Lily.

sentences.en: He is a very good writer.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常好的作家。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam writes words in a small notebook with a pen.

sentences.en: He looks at the food menu.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam holds a paper menu in his hands while sitting at a table.
